edits.scope: Correct Taehun's misplaced left arm only
edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target. Repair ONLY the girl's LEFT ARM anatomy. Her left shoulder is on the VIEWER'S RIGHT. Draw that left arm naturally descending from that shoulder along her own left side, with a gentle elbow bend and a relaxed left hand beside her hip on the viewer's right. Remove the isolated phantom hand currently resting on the trolley handle at the viewer's left; the trolley handle should be empty. Keep exactly TWO arms and TWO hands: her right hand still holds the book in the existing position, her repaired left hand rests beside her left hip. Preserve her face, expression, hair braid, full clothing, legs, book, trolley, library shelves, camera framing, sunlight, dimensions, crisp anime linework and all other details. Do not redesign the character, add people, or change composition. This is only a small anatomical cleanup.
edits.outputReview: No background ordinary students; corrected only misplaced left arm/phantom hand.

edits.scope: Correct both ankles and planted feet, with modest camera pullback so both whole shoes remain inside frame
edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the current edit target. Make a narrow framing-and-ankle correction ONLY. Pull the camera backward slightly, about 20 percent, so the SAME girl's entire body including BOTH complete ankles and BOTH whole loafers is visible, with a small margin of floor below the soles. Do not cut either foot at the lower frame. Show a stable natural standing stance: knees, shins, ankle joints and shoe directions anatomically coherent, both soles resting on the observatory floor, no twisted backward feet, crossed joints, floating shoe or dislocated ankle. Maintain her existing three-quarter rear body orientation and looking back over her shoulder, inviting open palm extended toward viewer. Keep her identity and face as closely as possible: same gentle shy smile, taupe side braid, violet eyes, muted lavender-gray cardigan, white collar, navy bow, dark plaid skirt, opaque dark tights, dark loafers, star accessories. Fully clothed ordinary teen school-life illustration, no sexualized pose or body emphasis. Preserve the original doorframe foreground, observatory room, covered telescope, red low safety lights, sunset window, stools, colors, crisp anime ink and cel shading, and original 16:9 horizontal aspect ratio. The only camera change is the modest wider framing required to show both whole shoes. Do not redesign her, change her hand gesture, add students, or introduce any new props.
edits.outputReview: Both complete shoes and ankles are now visible with floor margin. Knee-shin-ankle directions and soles form a natural supported stance. Same over-shoulder face, outstretched palm, cardigan, covered telescope, doorframe and red dusk atmosphere retained.
